To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the tunability of coupled elastic waves in periodically laminated aniseotropic piezoelectrics can be realized by switching between different kinds of electrical boundaries and by altering the capacitances or gain coefficients of the external capacitances or feedback voltages, and that the band structures of these coupled waves are more sensitive, if they are sensitive, to the electrical boundaries than to the material anistropy.
the coupled elastic wave modes are more tunable than pure P- and pure S-wave modes in periodically multilaminated piezoelectrics.

the coupled elastic wave bands in periodically laminated anistropic piezoelectric crystals are more sensitive to the material anistropy and the electrical boundaries than pure P- and pure S-wave bands.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the band tunability of coupled elastic waves in periodically laminated anistropic piezoelectric phononic crystals.
the dispersion properties of coupled elastic waves in anisotropic phononic crystals.
the band tunability of coupled elastic waves in periodically layered piezoelectric crystals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the tunability of coupled elastic waves in periodically laminated anistropic piezoelectric phononic crystals is much better than that of pure P- and pure S-waves.
the band properties of coupled elastic waves in periodically laminated aniseotropic piezoelectrics can be actively tuned by the electrical boundaries.

the tunability of band structure for coupled elastic waves along thickness in periodically laminated anistropic piezoelectric phononic crystals is much more complicated than that of pure waves, and the coupled wave modes are more sensitive to the electrical boundaries than pure wave modes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

this paper provides a new approach for actively tuning coupled elastic waves along thickness in periodically laminated anistropic piezoelectric crystals, and that the tunability of coupled elastic waves is more efficient than the pure waves.

, in the case of coupled elastic waves in laminated piezocomposites, the electrical boundaries play an important role in the band structures, so that the band structures can be actively tuned by the external capacitance and feedback-voltage control.
, by exploiting the coupling effect of the elastic and electric fields, the tunability efficiency of coupled elastic waves can be significantly enhanced.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the band properties of coupled elastic waves in periodically laminated aniseotropic piezoelectrics can be actively tuned by the electrical boundaries, which may have potential application in the design of tunable phononic devices.
the coupled wave band structures in the concerned periodically multilayer piezoelectric phononic crystals are tunable, and the tunability is more efficient than that of pure wave modes.
the coupled waves can be used to improve the tunability of band structures of the phononic crystals, particularly in the case of the phononic crystal composed of anisotropic materials.
